Name: Skip Intro
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Skip the intro logos, and optionally skip straight to the load or co-op screen.
Description:
**Skip Intro** lets you instantly skip the intro logos and screen transition (and optionally skip straight to the load or co-op screen). Combine with [Fast Animations](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089) to get into the game even faster.

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. Install [the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, or Windows;
  * single player or multiplayer (even if other players don't have it).
* No known mod conflicts.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)

The mod will automatically skip to the title screen. You can optionally [edit the mod settings](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/SkipIntro#configure) to skip to the load or co-op screen instead.

The mod gets you to the load screen much faster than any vanilla method:
* Double-click the first logo: 13 seconds.
* Press ESC at the first logo: 5 seconds.
* Skip Intro: 2 seconds.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
